title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world? Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We're looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you'll do..
As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who've already shown interest
Understand what they're building, why it matters, and where they're stuck
Clearly position Oneday's programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates This is not a passive customer success role.
It's a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You'll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results What you'll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

What You'll Do
Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
Take ownership of your practice's strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation What You Bring
Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics

An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice This is the ideal next step if you're seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.
By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Sap basis upgrades sum and conversion specialist
description:
We are seeking skilled SAP Basis Experts to execute complex SAP system upgrades and conversions, The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in SAP Basis, a strong understanding of SAP architecture, and hands-on experience with SAP system conversions, upgrades, copies and migrations.
Key Responsibilities:7+ years of Basis Experience
Plan and execute SAP system upgrades (Net Weaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel) across development, quality, and production environments.
Lead SAP S/4 HANA system conversions from ECC, including pre-checks, simplification item analysis, and custom code remediation.
Utilize tools such as SUM (Software Update Manager), Maintenance Planner, DMO (Database Migration Option), and SPAM/SAINT.
Experience in Update, System copies and Client copies
Perform OS/DB migrations, Unicode conversions, and HANA database upgrades.
Conduct mock conversions, dry runs, and cutover planning for production migrations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compatibility and readiness for upgrades and conversions.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during and post-upgrade/conversion.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of upgrade/conversion procedures and lessons learned.
Stay current with SAP's roadmap, release strategy, and best practices for upgrades and conversions.
ECS experience is added advantage

description:
Job Title: Implementation Analyst
English Resume Only
Location: Brazil
Type: Full-Time Contract
Setup: Fully Remote
Level: Mid-Level
Industry: Software SAAS Company
Shift: US Hours
Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment: Available upon request
Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000
About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.
About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.
Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems

title: Senior collections policy analyst

description:

description:

Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.

title: Talent manager - independent contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)
**Must send resume in English**
Overview:
The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Management
Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate. Administrative
Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree
Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting) Technical Requirements:
Fully remote position
High-speed, stable internet connection
Professional-grade webcam
High-quality speakerphone or headset
Modern computer with reliable performance
Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software Personal Attributes:
Empathetic and active listener
Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
Patient and persistent in building relationships
Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker)
description:
Company Description
Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.
Role Description
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents
Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy
Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups
Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries
Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance
Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials
Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)
Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations
Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism Qualifications
Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases
Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures
Excellent organizational and time-management skills
Strong written and verbal communication abilities
Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only To Apply
To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

Vem com a gente no desafio de construir o lugar no mundo de muita gente?

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil ou Arquitetura;
Conhecimento em Auto CAD para leitura e análise crítica de projetos;
Conhecimento em Pacote Office, com foco em Excel e Power Point;

Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, com rotina externa frequente;

Analisar tecnicamente potenciais terrenos para aquisição pela companhia, avaliando aspectos urbanísticos, técnicos e mercadológicos;
Realizar a contratação de estudos técnicos para terrenos em fase de análise ou já negociados comercialmente, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos contratuais para atendimento das resolutivas;

Elaborar análises econômico-financeiras dos terrenos, incluindo estudos de viabilidade, custos e VGV, utilizando planilhas em Excel;
Controlar, atualizar e acompanhar a base de despesas relacionadas aos estudos preliminares de terrenos, mantendo planilhas de controle e indicadores atualizados;
Conduzir o processo de pagamento de fornecedores referentes aos serviços técnicos contratados, garantindo conformidade com prazos e processos internos;
Levantar e analisar legislações urbanísticas, zoneamento e regras específicas da região, avaliando a adequação dos terrenos aos produtos e diretrizes da companhia;
Atuar em interface com corretores, proprietários de terrenos, fornecedores técnicos, concessionárias e áreas internas, apoiando o avanço das negociações e análises.

title: Technical business analyst id52085
description:
Job Description Agile Engine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.
WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Business Analyst in data and digital transformation, you will play a pivotal role in connecting business goals with technical solutions, shaping how teams leverage data and integrations across the organization. You’ll influence the design of processes, pipelines, and analytics, driving efficiency and insight while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, contributing directly to measurable impact and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative culture.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Partner with stakeholders across departments to capture and validate business needs
- Translate business concepts into structured technical requirements, use cases, and user stories
- Define data and integration requirements in collaboration with architects
- Map current- and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency
- Maintain a clear traceability matrix linking business requests to delivered functionality
- Work with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to clarify metric definitions, data transformations, and aggregation rules
- Support efforts to standardize KPIs and enable self-service analytics using BI tools
- Validate data outputs and ensure alignment with business definitions and governance standards
- Collaborate with data governance leadership to ensure quality, compliance, and consistent usage of data assets
- Assist in the design and implementation of new data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations across cloud environments
- Partner with architects to document data lineage, source-to-target mappings, and system dependencies
- Analyze and communicate technical constraints, data availability, and system impacts to business sponsors
- Coordinate with engineering teams to perform user acceptance testing and validate results
MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Product Owner in data, IT, or digital transformation contexts
- Strong ability to bridge business language and technical concepts
- Knowledge of data systems, BPMN tools (e.g., Camunda), and integration frameworks (e.g., Boomi, APIs)
- Strong understanding of AWS core services, including EC2, Lambda, S3, VPC, Cloud Formation, API Gateway, and RDS
- Experience writing detailed functional specifications, user stories, process diagrams, and acceptance criteria
- Understanding of data modeling concepts, ETL pipelines, and BI/reporting workflows
- Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
- Collaborative approach in team settings spanning technical and business disciplines
- Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries
- Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira/Confluence, and data catalog systems
- Upper-intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
- Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries
- Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, and data catalog systems
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, Tech Talks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.
Meet Our Recruitment Process
It includes main stages:
Application→ Coding Challenge→ Video Interview→ Technical Interview or Interview with the Hiring Manager(s).

title: Senior analytics engineer
description:
Company Description
United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.
Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Will Do
Semantic Modeling
Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context
Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness
Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality
Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Qualifications
Required
5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have
Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Salesforce developer
description:
Company Description
We are a software startup dedicated to unifying ERP and CRM solutions into one seamless platform. As we prepare for growth, we are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer that has hands-on experience, particularly with integrations and solution design and implementation.
Role Description
This is a full-time remote position for a Salesforce Developer. The Salesforce Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and customizing Salesforce solutions, including creating and optimizing Visualforce Pages and Lightning Web Components. Responsibilities also include Salesforce.com administration, integration with other enterprise applications, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable and secure solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet business requirements is integral to this role. While remote, this role will be working during Eastern Standard Timezone (US) hours from 8am to 5pm.

Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions

2–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related field
Strong expertise in Salesforce Lightning (LWC/Aura)
Experience with Agentic AI or AI-based solutions is a plus
Solid understanding of Apex, Triggers, Workflows, SOQL/SOSL, and integrations
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Experience with Salesforce.com Administration tasks and configuration
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with cross-functional teams
Salesforce Developer Certification or equivalent is preferred
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote, global environment
Customize UI/UX within Salesforce Company Perks & Benefits
Observance of major US Federal Holidays
10 Paid Vacation Days + 5 Personal Days + 5 Sick Days in the 1st year of employment
Annual performance bonus
Client and employee referral bonus program

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:

About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience
Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.
Role Description
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.
Key Responsibilities

Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications

Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain's GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience

title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
description:

O Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;

Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);

Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;

Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;
Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;
Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;

Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;

Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais. Habilidades Requeridas
Proficiência em mandarim
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;
Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;
Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;
Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;
Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;
Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;
Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;
Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);
Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;
Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;
Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação. Atributos
Proatividade;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;
Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;
Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;
Trabalho em equipe;
Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);
Senso de urgência;
Multitarefa;
Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;
Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.
Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.
Sobre a posição
Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.
Principais responsabilidades:
Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes. O que buscamos:
Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes. Perfil desejado:
Proatividade e autonomia;
Forte orientação para resultados;
Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade. Modelo de trabalho
Atuação majoritariamente em campo, com base em home office e disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Business development manager
description:
About Us:
Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.
Responsibilities
Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth. Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.

Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods. Equal Employment Statement

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Desenvolvedor .net
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor. NET Core
⸻
Sobre o Wite Group / Wite Tec
O Wite Group, por meio da Wite Tec, é uma empresa orientada à construção de produtos digitais com impacto real no negócio. Atuamos com alto nível de responsabilidade técnica, foco em eficiência operacional e compromisso com entrega consistente em ambiente de produção. Não somos uma empresa de experimentação superficial — valorizamos profissionais que assumem ownership, tomam decisões e sustentam sistemas críticos com qualidade e previsibilidade.
⸻
Sobre a posição
Buscamos um desenvolvedor. NET Core com forte capacidade de execução, que saiba transformar demandas em soluções funcionais, escaláveis e seguras. O profissional será responsável por atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas em produção, com autonomia para propor melhorias e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega.
Não buscamos apenas alguém que "sabe programar", mas alguém que resolve problemas reais, entende impacto de negócio e entrega com consistência.
⸻
Responsabilidades
• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações utilizando. NET Core
• Trabalhar com APIs REST de forma estruturada e performática
• Garantir qualidade de código, legibilidade e manutenção a longo prazo
• Participar de decisões técnicas com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade
• Atuar na identificação e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo
• Colaborar com outras áreas (produto, dados, operações) para entregar soluções completas
• Assumir responsabilidade direta por entregas, prazos e estabilidade do sistema
⸻
Requisitos técnicos (Hard Skills)
• Domínio prático de. NET Core e C#
• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST
• Conhecimento sólido em banco de dados (SQL Server ou similar)
• Entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas (camadas, separação de responsabilidades)
• Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)
• Capacidade de debugar, identificar e resolver problemas reais em produção
• Noções de performance, segurança e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
⸻
Competências comportamentais (Soft Skills)
• Alto senso de responsabilidade (não terceiriza problema)
• Capacidade de execução sem depender de microgerenciamento
• Pensamento crítico e orientação à solução
• Organização e clareza na comunicação
• Maturidade para lidar com pressão e priorização
• Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir
⸻
Observação final
Buscamos um profissional com alto nível de execução, que entrega, sustenta e evolui sistemas com responsabilidade real. Aqui, resultado prático é mais importante do que discurso técnico.

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias: Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/Postgres
Visão geral da posição
Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.
Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma Qualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.
Saiba como o Autodesk Construction Cloud pode ajudar suas equipes a colaborar com segurança e rapidez em todas as fases do projeto, permitindo entregas dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

title: Fx trader
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.

Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development

Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements

Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:
Web3 DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.
As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based), offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.
This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights. What You'll Be Doing
Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. What We're Looking For
2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
Strong understanding of blockchain, De Fi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation. Why Join Web3 DXB
Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems. If you're passionate about Web3, AI, and investing, and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we'd love to connect.

title: Staff software engineer (java/react)
description:

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.
Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.
At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.
We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.

Experience designing and building backend services using Java and the Spring Boot framework, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

Availability to travel to Australia for an expected period of time of 2-3 months.

title: Talent manager - independent contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)
**Must send resume in English**
Overview:
The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Management
Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate. Administrative
Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree
Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting) Technical Requirements:
Fully remote position
High-speed, stable internet connection
Professional-grade webcam
High-quality speakerphone or headset
Modern computer with reliable performance
Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software Personal Attributes:
Empathetic and active listener
Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
Patient and persistent in building relationships
Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Coordenador financeiro / contas a pagar
description:
Quem somos
A Valuement, parte do Grupo Mantu, é uma consultoria internacional especialista em Source to Pay. Atuamos com clientes globais, ajudando a aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a performance em contas a pagar, gestão de fornecedores e processos financeiros internos.
O Grupo Mantu, fundado em 2007, possui mais de 12.000 profissionais em 60 países, com faturamento anual de aproximadamente 1 bilhão de euros. Com expertise em transformação empresarial, tecnologia, marketing digital e gestão de talentos, o grupo oferece soluções estratégicas e inovadoras para clientes em diversos setores e regiões do mundo.
Descrição da vaga
Buscamos um Coordenador Financeiro / Contas a Pagar para atuar diretamente com nossos clientes globais, identificando oportunidades de otimização, eficiência e melhoria de processos financeiros.
Suas responsabilidades:
Analisar e monitorar processos de contas a pagar dos clientes, identificando inconsistências, duplicidades e oportunidades de economia
Colaborar com equipes de Procurement e Financeiro dos clientes para otimização de pagamentos e contratos
Desenvolver KPIs e dashboards para acompanhamento da performance financeira
Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos
Atuar como elo entre o cliente, fornecedores e stakeholders internos da Valuement Seu perfil
Experiência comprovada em contas a pagar, tesouraria ou controladoria
Domínio avançado de sistemas ERP (SAP, Totvs, Oracle, etc.)
Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, relatórios)
Forte capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes
Excelente comunicação para interações com clientes, fornecedores e áreas internas
Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de influenciar stakeholders
Fluência em português; inglês é diferencial
Experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos financeiros e otimização de fluxos O que oferecemos
Uma comunidade global com mais de 110 nacionalidades
Uma cultura baseada em confiança, onde 70% dos líderes-chave começaram em cargos de entrada
Um forte sistema de aprendizado com nossa Academia interna e mais de 250 módulos de treinamento
Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com encontros informais, atividades de team-building e eventos sociais
Compromisso sólido com Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR), especialmente por meio do programa We Care Together Se você é um profissional entusiasmado, focado em gerar impacto e deseja se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica e em rápido crescimento, adoraríamos receber sua candidatura!
Diversidade & Inclusão
A Valuement tem orgulho de ser uma empresa de oportunidades iguais. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma força de trabalho diversificada e um ambiente inclusivo. Por isso, recebemos candidaturas de todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, crenças, idade, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.
